P.name: Blast Shield
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} Periodically, '''Vi's''' next {{tip|ability}} hit grants her a {{tip|shield}} equal to {{as|12% of her '''maximum''' health}} for 3 seconds.
P.description2: ''Blast Shield's'' {{sti|cooldown}} is reduced by 4 seconds each time ''{{ai|Denting Blows|Vi}}'' is consumed.
P.static: {{pp|16 to 12 for 9|formula=16.5 - 0.5 * level, capped at level 9}}

Q.name: Vault Breaker
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vi''' {{tip|channel|charges}} while being {{tip|slow|slowed}} by 15% for up to 4 seconds to increase ''Vault Breaker's'' {{sti|range}}, speed, and damage over the first {{fd|1.25}} seconds of the channel.
Q.description2: ''Vault Breaker'' can be recast within the duration. If the charge completes without reactivation, ''Vault Breaker'' is cancelled, {{sti|mana|{{as|50% of the mana cost}}}} is refunded, and it is placed on {{sti|cd|full cooldown}}. If the charge is {{tip|interrupt|interrupted}}, {{sti|mana|{{as|50% of the mana cost}}}} is refunded and it is placed on a {{sti|cd|3-second cooldown}}.
Q.description3: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Vi''' {{tip|dashes}} in the target direction to deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies within her path, increased by {{pp|type=channel time|key=%|0 to 150 for 11|0 to 1.25|round1=3|formula=15% per 0.125 seconds. ''This is capped at 1.25 seconds.''}}, and {{tip|airborne|pull}} all non-champions hit towards her.
Q.leveling3: {{st|Minimum Physical Damage|{{ap|40 to 120}} {{as|(+ 60% '''bonus''' AD)}}|Maximum Physical Damage|{{ap|40*2.5 to 120*2.5}} {{as|(+ {{ap|60*2.5}}% '''bonus''' AD)}}}}
Q.description4: She stops upon hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} over {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
Q.description5: ''{{ai|Relentless Force|Vi}} and {{ai|Cease and Desist|Vi}} can be cast during the dash.''

W.name: Denting Blows
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} '''Vi's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and ''{{ai|Vault Breaker|Vi}}'' apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Denting Blows'' to enemies hit for 4 seconds, refreshing on subsequent applications and stacking up to 3 times. The third stack consumes them all to deal {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}, capped at 300 against non-champions, and inflict {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|20% armor reduction}}}} for 4 seconds.
W.leveling: {{st|Bonus Physical Damage|{{as|{{ap|4 to 8}}% {{as|(+ {{fd|3.5}}% per 100 '''bonus''' AD)}} of target's '''maximum''' health}}}}
W.description2: After consuming ''Denting Blows'', '''Vi''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds, which refreshes on subsequent triggers.

W.description2: After consuming ''Denting Blows'', '''Vi''' gains {{sti|as|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} for 4 seconds, which refreshes on subsequent triggers.

E.name: Relentless Force
E.description:
{{sbc|Active:}} '''Vi''' empowers her next basic attack within 6 seconds to have an {{tip|uncancellable windup}}, gain {{sti|range|50 '''bonus''' range}} and trigger a blast in the target's direction that deals {{as|'''modified''' physical damage}} to enemies hit in a cone.

''Relentless Force'' can {{tip|critically strike}} for {{as|{{critical damage|{{ccd|Vi|crit_base}}|100|base=100}}|critical damage}} {{as|AD}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}} against the primary target. Secondary targets take the same damage but do not count as being critically struck.
E.description2: '''Vi''' periodically [[stock]]s a ''Relentless Force'' charge, up to a maximum of 2.
E.description3: ''Relentless Force {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Vi's''' basic attack timer.''

R.name: Cease and Desist
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Vi''' singles out the target enemy {{tip|champion}}, {{tip|dash|dashing}} with {{tip|displacement immunity}} towards them and {{tip|true sight|revealing}} them. Upon approaching within 300 units of the target, she {{tip|dashes}} through and grabs them over {{tt|{{fd|1.05}} seconds|Estimated}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them up}} for {{fd|1.3}} seconds and dealing {{as|physical damage}} after {{fd|0.75}} seconds into the grab duration.
R.description2: Enemies she dashes through are dealt the same damage, {{tip|airborne|knocked aside}} by 350 units over {{fd|0.25}} seconds, and {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
